snippet.title: Hallowed Legends: Templar
snippet.description:
iPad: http://bigfi.sh/1gxEyZ1
iPhone: http://bigfi.sh/1kZqdrj

Visit the south of France to stop a group of mysterious Knights Templar that have overtaken a small town. Uncover the truth, fight a terrible foe, and save the town and your family. 

• STOP THE KNIGHTS TEMPLAR! 
You've received a call for help from your brother's wife. Your brother has gone missing and mysterious figures that resemble the Templars of old have invaded their town. 

• SOLVE A DARK MYSTERY 
Uncover the truth of what the Templars want, who they're working for and why they were drawn to this town. 

• ENJOY THE EPIC STORY! 
Investigate a beautiful, but dangerous, French town. Experience the breathtaking journey through integrated live-action cut scenes. 

• UNLOCK THIS COLLECTOR'S EDITION AND ACCESS THE FANTASTIC BONUS EXTRAS 
Question all you've learned when you play the exciting bonus game. Listen to the haunting soundtrack and check out the unique wallpapers and beautiful concept art in this exciting Hidden Objects Puzzle Adventure. 

TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
